status: experimental_compute_block; validation status is bound in SOURCE_SHA256.json
scope: Independent compute block, one complete 99x64 times 64x16 tile

format.output: per-channel RNE right shift then signed8 saturation
format.configuration_source: unchanged frozen original x8_w8_y8_h0 training configs

public_interface.start: start_valid/start_ready accepts one task; no multiple outstanding tasks
public_interface.load: load_valid/load_ready/load_data[31:0], exactly 1868 accepted words in the fixed order below
public_interface.status: busy, done pulse after final output ACK, error for invalid shift metadata
public_interface.cycles: total, load, cold-factor, compute and store cycle counters; stalls included in their phases

load_layout.packing: two adjacent signed16 channel biases, low channel in low half
four adjacent unsigned8 shift values, low channel in low byte

output_layout: word i=0..395: row=i>>2, first_channel=4*(i&3), four adjacent signed8 outputs packed little-endian

storage.X: 8 physical qingyu_sram16 banks DEPTH1024 WIDTH16; bank=row%8, address=(row/8)*32+k_pair
storage.W: 16 physical qingyu_sram16 banks DEPTH128 WIDTH16; bank=channel, address=k_pair
storage.small_metadata_registers: 16 signed16 bias,16 shift8; global R8/C16 retained directly in the24 frozen factor units' out_factor registers, with no additional shadow copies; controller/factor pipeline registers also counted
storage.output_storage: 128 raw pair accumulators each hold their signed23 sum until packed output ACK; accumulator doubles as result storage, no separate Y SRAM or metadata copies per PE
storage.asic_mapping: project rtl/asic/qingyu_sram16.sv uses official 128/1024 sizes; actual foundry model/area/STA not claimed

factor_contract: All C generated by hardware once per task; each 8-row group generates its R in hardware before reuse across 16 channels. Factors invalidated on every new task/reset. No software-supplied factors and no reuse across tasks.
initial_schedule: cold load -> column factors -> for 13 row groups: row factors -> 32 paired MAC issues -> correction/results -> serialized packed outputs. Compute/store deliberately sequential in first milestone; all phase cycles reported.
read_pipeline: one synchronous SRAM read latency followed by frozen factor or new raw pair-accumulator elastic pipeline; controller must never drop an issued read when consumer is not ready
metadata_sharing: R8/C16/bias16/shift16 retained globally for the current task/group; each PE only product18/accumulator23 and valid/first/last controls. Four shared factor/bias correction and RNE paths serialize four INT8 results per ACK. No next group or metadata epoch before all current group results ACK.
tail: last group has three real rows; other rows must not emit outputs or consume stale factors/data
abort: hardware reset invalidates all partially loaded data, factors and outstanding outputs; a subsequent task must reload every real X/W and metadata word
verification_plan: Use unchanged frozen INT8 configs, source/weight hashes, and declared validation sample index9 for all12 layers and all16 channel tiles (192 cases)
Expected outputs and pre-RNE accumulators come from an independent direct64-product integer model; do not use Winograd formula for golden results
Compare each of1584 accumulators and396 packed output words per tile; exact count/index/tail checks
Add full-range signed8 extreme/random tiles and metadata/bias/RNE boundaries
Random load/output stalls, held-output payload checks, reset during load/factor/compute/stalled output, complete restart
Check physical SRAM instance count and array depths; source/hash manifest; strict RTL lint; no unmeasured PPA estimates
known_limits: This prototype does not include FIO, CPU, shared SRAM, official bus, source loading or complete full256-channel task timing
The1868-word FIO-facing proposal is a future transport format, not an implemented official bus path
Reusing X or factors across the16 channel tiles of one future full task needs an explicit lifetime protocol and cold-task boundary
128 9x9 pair multipliers plus24 8x8 factor multipliers and their registers are nonfree logic; area/energy pending synthesis
Four shared factor/bias correction and RNE paths may be critical; 150MHz remains unverified
